title: Annoying infotainment and convenience issues
summary: Reviews in this topic describe various irritating usability problems, including waiting delays, radio behavior during calls, eSIM malfunction, and features found closed or not working as expected.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention annoyance with waiting for functions, the radio not switching off during calls, eSIM features not functioning correctly, and returning to find items closed.

limitations: This cluster mixes several different annoyance-related issues rather than one clearly defined product problem.
Most fragments are brief and provide limited context about the exact feature, trigger, or condition involved.
